scope: P3-03 deterministic full/summary/selected context, actual SDK Provider wire accounting and immutable lossy summary artifacts.
known_limitations: One synthetic fixture measured full 8675, summary 2080 and selected 1483 actual UTF-8 context bytes. This is accounting evidence, not a model quality, latency or general performance claim.

Budget covers actual snapshot_json including references and escaping; excludes goal, tool declarations, observations and HTTP envelope. Token estimates use named ceil(UTF-8 bytes/4), not actual tokenizer usage or billing.
The authorized candidate set is the fixed snapshot's direct-dependency set, not arbitrary Run history. Goal/retrieved text can affect relevance scores but cannot change tools or ACL.

Summary mode in trusted Store writes CAS bytes, immutable kind=summary metadata, source IDs/hashes, snapshot lineage and an audit event without marking Task succeeded. Actual independent processes checked summary idempotence. The offline CLI only exercises trusted fixtures and does not authenticate Workers.
Retained actual failures include missing selection schema, Unicode separator wire mismatch and PostgreSQL UUID/text parameter inference. Final regression has no skip/xfail.
No independent Verifier, autonomous Worker dispatch, paid model calls or production database operations. Evidence captured before local commit; coding commits not pushed.
